name: Cham Islands food guide
summary: Order the catch with rice: fish soup, fish braised lightly or salty, fried fish, and dried fish grilled or simmered. Mực một nắng is tube squid dried one sun. Bánh ít and bánh su sê sit in baskets at the pier. A current stall price is Check on arrival.
body: The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study still puts the catch first: fish, shrimp, squid, and swimming crab, then greens, then meat, with little spice. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00. For a change, that study names braised pork, boiled pork, pork-bone soup, salty glazed ribs, and stir-fried meat with roots and fruit, plus bún and mì with no recipe. Lobster, ốc vú nàng, and abalone have left the daily table. Stone crab is a visitor catch, and only inside the season on its own line.

Mực một nắng is the squid dried one sun. Nước lá Lao is the leaf drink: the 7 July 2014 note calls it particular to the island, and the centre’s 25 June 2017 note says the same leaves are known elsewhere in Quảng. Bánh ít and bánh su sê are the cakes in the pier baskets. Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm is a registered product. The Đà Nẵng city portal on 28 May 2026 quotes grades from nearly 100 million to nearly 180 million VND a kilogram. That is not a bowl price.
specialtiesLead: Squid dried one sun is the plate with a photograph. The other names are plates the Hội An World Heritage centre, its inventory, Báo Quảng Nam, the Đà Nẵng city portal, and the reserve decision actually print.

sections.heading: Plates from the catch
paragraphs: The daily rice is the list the 16 September 2025 study prints: fish soup, fish braised lightly, fish braised salty, fried fish, cá cháy, and dried fish grilled or simmered, plus the fish paste and the cakes and drinks around it. A current price on every line is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Afternoon noodles
paragraphs: The 16 September 2025 study names mì Quảng with bánh xèo chả cá, bánh canh, and bánh bèo as afternoon food along the Bai Lang coast road and by the well in Bai Ong. It does not describe the noodles, the broth, or a shop.

sections.heading: Breakfast on the coast road
paragraphs: The same study places breakfast stalls along the Bai Lang coast road and by Giếng Xóm Cấm in Bai Ong. It does not name the breakfast dish. A stall hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bai Lang coast road
spots.address: Thôn Bãi Làng, xã Tân Hiệp
spots.note: Breakfast stalls the Hội An World Heritage centre places along this road on 16 September 2025, and by the well in Bai Ong. No stall hour and no stall price were printed. Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Cham Islands food — the catch and squid dried one sun
seoDescription: Fish with rice, squid dried one sun, and bánh ít at the pier on Tân Hiệp. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00. A stall price is Check on arrival.
